facts.text: Both my hands and both my feet have been getting bigger.
They've kept on getting bigger over time.
I sweat too much.

facts.item: skin folds on the forehead and scalp
facts.text: I have prominent folds of skin on my forehead and scalp.

facts.item: how long the enlargement, sweating and skin folds have been there
facts.text: All of this has been developing over 10 years.
Both my knees hurt.
It's mild.
It crept up on me gradually.
Over-the-counter medicines relieve it.
My knees and ankles are swollen.
The tips of my fingers and toes are swollen and rounded.
I haven't had any fevers.
I haven't had chest pain.
I haven't had any rashes.
My voice hasn't changed.
I haven't had headaches.
I haven't had any problems with my vision.
I don't have any known lung disease.
I don't have any known heart disease.
I don't have any known hormone or gland disease.
I don't have any known rheumatic disease.
I smoke three to four cigarettes a day.
I drink alcohol twice a week.
No one in my family has had anything like this.

findings.name: face and scalp inspection
findings.result: Coarse facial features; multiple skin folds on the forehead; cutis verticis gyrata of the scalp.

findings.name: inspection of the limbs
findings.result: Marked enlargement of both hands, feet and distal forearms.

findings.name: joint examination
findings.result: Swelling of both knees and ankles.

findings.name: fingers, toes and nails
findings.result: Grade IV clubbing of all fingers and toes.

findings.name: muscle bulk
findings.result: Symmetrically reduced in the upper arms and thighs.

findings.name: autoimmune serology
findings.result: Antinuclear antibody, rheumatoid factor and anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody: normal.

findings.name: knee radiographs
findings.result: Diffuse cortical thickening of the distal femoral diaphyses and metaphyses with periosteal reaction; similar but milder changes in the tibiae and fibulae.

findings.name: ankle and foot radiographs
findings.result: Cortical thickening with a fluffy periosteal reaction in the tibiae and fibulae; milder involvement of the talus and navicular.

findings.name: hand radiographs
findings.result: Cortical thickening and periosteal reaction of the radius, ulna, and the middle and proximal phalanges of all fingers.
